transfer_rule: Use a dominant circular chamber, one narrow information rail and a compressed technical footer. Replace the fossil with an original KODEX relic or cosmology core.
do_not_copy: ammonite shell | exact sun glyph | lettering | source diagrams

transfer_rule: Reserve one-third for a command rail and two-thirds for an original specimen. Give the specimen a slow respiration and the emission a faster turbulent layer.
do_not_copy: exact mask | Japanese lettering | radiation symbol | barcode

transfer_rule: Use three equal temporal windows showing one KODEX organism in successive states. Keep the title rail static while the images mutate.
do_not_copy: photographic eye | exact title | three source frames

transfer_rule: Use one central KODEX subject inside several independent orbital systems. Peripheral data must move at different rates so the field feels computational rather than decorative.
do_not_copy: sleeping figure | exact spiral | source slogans | source symbols

transfer_rule: Use a strict vertical stack: biological signal, dominant time/status readout and modular controls. The clock is semantic state, not decoration.
do_not_copy: face | 20:01 numerals | source logo | source footer

transfer_rule: Keep one slow full-height organic field and anchor it with a rigid left instrument column. Floating windows should move slower than the cursor.
do_not_copy: source marbling | insomnia wordmark | source icons | source signature

transfer_rule: Assign 58–65% of the canvas to an original KODEX specimen and 35–42% to records. The bridge between them must represent a live signal.
do_not_copy: warrior statue | brain drawing | wordmark | source labels

transfer_rule: Use a repeated headline plus a 2×2 field where every quadrant has a distinct motion tempo. One quadrant may be perspective/depth.
do_not_copy: earth globe | wire hand | human silhouettes | source slogans

transfer_rule: Use a disciplined two-panel perspective system: one warped surface and one directional corridor. Keep the palette nearly binary.
do_not_copy: new world title | skull icon | exact vortex | exact terrain

transfer_rule: Use a dominant machine chamber, one explicit control row and two secondary result windows. The controls must change state, not merely decorate.
do_not_copy: source orbital machine | source buttons | source title | source outputs
